q.en: Your friend Anu does not want to hold hands in the school line. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhari dost Anu school ki line mein haath nahi pakadna chahti. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Hold her hand anyway
options.hg: Phir bhi uska haath pakad lo

options.en: Say 'okay' and walk next to her
options.hg: 'Okay' bolo aur uske saath-saath chalo

options.en: Tell her you are not her friend any more
options.hg: Usse bol do ki ab tum uske dost nahi ho

explain.en: Anu is the boss of her body. Saying okay shows you respect her, and you can still be friends.
explain.hg: Anu apni body ki boss hai. 'Okay' bolna dikhata hai ki tum uski respect karte ho, aur tum phir bhi dost reh sakte ho.

q.en: Which of these is a safe secret?
q.hg: Inme se safe secret kaun sa hai?

options.en: An older girl saying 'don't tell anyone that I message you'
options.hg: Kisi badi ladki ka bolna, 'kisi ko mat batana ki main tumhe message karti hoon'

options.en: A neighbour giving you money to stay quiet about a 'game'
options.hg: Padosi ka kisi 'game' ke baare mein chup rehne ke liye paise dena

options.en: Planning a surprise birthday party for your sister
options.hg: Apni behen ke liye surprise birthday party ki planning

explain.en: A safe secret ends soon and makes people happy. Secrets about messages, money or games with an older person are unsafe and should be told.
explain.hg: Safe secret jaldi khatam ho jaata hai aur logon ko khush karta hai. Kisi bade ke saath messages, paise ya game wale secrets unsafe hain aur bata dene chahiye.

q.en: Which of these is an example of coercion?
q.hg: Inme se coercion ka example kaun sa hai?

options.en: Asking once and accepting the answer
options.hg: Ek baar poochna aur jawab accept kar lena

options.en: Saying 'no problem' when someone refuses
options.hg: Kisi ke mana karne par 'koi baat nahi' bolna

options.en: Checking whether the other person is comfortable
options.hg: Check karna ki saamne wala comfortable hai ya nahi

options.en: Saying 'I'll tell everyone your secret if you don't agree'
options.hg: Bolna, 'nahi maane toh main tumhara secret sabko bata doonga'

explain.en: A threat takes away the freedom to refuse. Any yes that follows it is not consent.
explain.hg: Dhamki mana karne ki freedom chheen leti hai. Uske baad mili koi bhi yes consent nahi hai.

q.en: Under the POCSO Act, an adult's sexual activity with a 17-year-old is an offence even if the 17-year-old said yes.
q.hg: POCSO Act ke under kisi adult ki 17 saal ke insaan ke saath sexual activity offence hai, chahe us 17 saal ke insaan ne 'yes' bola ho.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: POCSO treats everyone under 18 as a child, and a child's agreement is not legal consent to sexual activity.
explain.hg: POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, aur child ka agreement sexual activity ke liye legal consent nahi hai.

q.en: Which Indian law lets a married woman seek civil remedies, such as a protection order, for sexual abuse by her husband?
q.hg: Kaun sa Indian law married woman ko husband ke sexual abuse ke khilaaf protection order jaise civil remedies maangne deta hai?

options.en: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971
options.hg: Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971

options.en: Information Technology Act, 2000
options.hg: Information Technology Act, 2000

options.en: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
options.hg: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

options.en: POCSO Act, 2012
options.hg: POCSO Act, 2012

explain.en: The domestic violence law covers physical, emotional, economic and sexual abuse within the home and offers remedies outside the criminal definition of rape.
explain.hg: Domestic violence law ghar ke andar physical, emotional, economic aur sexual abuse ko cover karta hai aur rape ki criminal definition ke bahar bhi remedies deta hai.

q.en: A friend tells you they were harassed on the way home. Which question should you avoid?
q.hg: Ek dost batata hai ki ghar lautte waqt uske saath harassment hua. Kaun sa sawaal tumhe nahi poochna chahiye?

options.en: 'Why were you out there alone?'
options.hg: 'Tum wahan akele kya kar rahe the?'

options.en: 'What do you need right now?'
options.hg: 'Abhi tumhe kya chahiye?'

options.en: 'Do you want me to come with you to tell someone?'
options.hg: 'Kya main kisi ko batane tumhare saath chaloon?'

options.en: 'Would you like to sit somewhere quiet?'
options.hg: 'Kya tum kisi quiet jagah baithna chahoge?'

explain.en: 'Why' questions about the survivor's choices sound like blame. The harasser is the only one responsible.
explain.hg: Survivor ke choices par 'kyun' wale sawaal blame jaise lagte hain. Zimmedar sirf harass karne wala hai.
